opening.argument: The material is framed throughout as a television series episode, not as an appeal for financial participation. Its title identifies “Kyiv day and night - Series 8 - Season 2,” while the description explains that the format “combines the drama of the series and life stories” and places ordinary participants in “situations set by the script.” The 30,000 UAH withdrawal and missing-card material therefore functions as a character conflict: “Pasha is worried about the loss of the card and money,” and the reported withdrawal is presented within the depicted storyline. The recap framing, broadcaster branding, and interpersonal dialogue further support a scripted entertainment context rather than a request for credentials, money, or scheme participation.
